model.shared_feature_controls: The identical frozen BERT-Tiny CLS representation is used by all feature baselines.

claims.facts: Recall newly sampled random entity/field bindings under held-out text templates.
claims.procedure_selection: Recall a program identifier and compose supplied interpreter operations; this does not demonstrate arithmetic algorithm learning or learned topology.
claims.new_entities: Phase 1 adds new entities with equal source access for every method. Phase 0 evaluation exposes pre-write ignorance; phase 1 tests learning and old-entity retention.
claims.quality_route: Held-out accuracy improves over the strongest prespecified baseline, with separately reported complete measured service costs; requires stable independent seeds.
claims.utility_route: At 1000 reads in a one-hour service window, accuracy minus 0.01 per CPU wall-second/query minus 0.001 per GiB-hour/query exceeds every prespecified baseline; sensitivity at 1,10,100,10000 reads.

training.pretrained_backbone: Frozen except added LoRA deltas; dropout disabled equally for training/evaluation.
training.lora_targets: All BERT attention query and value projections
training.output_head: 128-to-8 linear; the matched feature_linear arm uses the same head.
training.replay: Phase 1 reuses old and new supervised examples with identical access for all arms.
training.fast_weights: Normalized delta-rule on frozen features, 12 passes, learning rate 0.4; no pretrained-transformer claim for this arm.

cost.feature_construction: Actually rerun and timed independently for each feature arm and write phase, using the same frozen backbone.
cost.read_measure: Both batched throughput and 48 sequential query samples, including required encoding and shared interpreter.
cost.strongest_structured_baseline: Exact source-bound KV receives raw query and source text, not evaluation labels.
cost.break_even: Extra write time divided by per-read time savings only if savings are positive; quality noninferiority separately required.
cost.boundary: Local CPU service: source admission, writes, fixed qualification, retained model and versions, checkpoint restore, and queries. No hyperparameter search or post-test tuning is permitted. Distributed migration is not deployed in this experiment.
